subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous, high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz time-series sensor payloads (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry) from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; enforces physical metric boundaries, reconciles out-of-order latency backfills, and buffers windowed telemetry streams for streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
subdomain.why_distinct: Described as a core domain component of an endurance athletic analytics platform with its own rules (boundary validation, 60-second reorder, append-only event revisions, backpressure) and its own timing language (t_device vs t_ingress).

ubiquitous_language.definition: Raw payload received from a device at the ingestion entry point, carrying Telemetry Samples.
Device-generated epoch timestamp; the chronological ordering basis.
Arrival time at ingestion; never used for chronological ordering.
60-second window within which delayed out-of-order packets are re-indexed by t_device.
Physical physiological/mechanical limits a metric value must respect.
Status flag tagged on invalid samples; payload is kept.
Demand-driven flow control at the ingestion entry point and toward downstream consumers.
Appended record representing a correction or backfilled frame; originals are never modified.
Buffered sliding-window sequence of validated samples broadcast to downstream event streams for streaming analytics.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Ingestion
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept Ingress Packets non-blockingly, validate each Telemetry Sample against Sensor Metric Boundaries, reorder by t_device within the Backfill Reorder Window, and persist append-only event revisions.
in_scope: Ingress Packet intake from IoT edge devices, bike computers, smart wearables
Reordering by Device Timestamp within 60 seconds
Append-only raw record storage with Event Revisions for corrections/backfills
invariants: Every raw 1Hz Telemetry Sample is validated against Sensor Metric Boundaries before downstream propagation (HR: 30-240 BPM, Power: 0-2500W, Cadence: 0-220 RPM, Swimming Pace: >45 sec/100m).
Invalid samples are tagged VALIDATION_FAILED and the underlying payload is never dropped.
Out-of-order packets delayed up to 60 seconds are re-indexed chronologically by t_device, not t_ingress.
Ingestion entry point maintains backpressure with zero blocking I/O on thread pools under burst loads.
Raw time-series records are strictly append-only; corrections and backfilled frames append new event revisions for auditability.
source_of_truth: Raw Telemetry Sample event history and its revisions

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Stream Distribution
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Buffer validated samples into sliding windows and broadcast them with backpressure to downstream event streams.
in_scope: Backpressure-aware broadcast to downstream event streams
invariants: Only samples already validated by Telemetry Ingestion are propagated downstream.
Broadcast honours downstream demand (backpressure) without blocking I/O.
source_of_truth: Current window buffer contents (derived, not authoritative)

assumptions.item: AMBIGUITY: delivery posture of Ingress Packets is not stated (at-most-once vs at-least-once). If at-least-once, which identity distinguishes a retry from a new event? Candidate natural identity (device, metric, t_device): is the mutable payload (corrected value) part of the identity or excluded, and what then separates a retry from a correction/backfill revision? Needs an owner decision.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Determines dedup duty inside Telemetry Ingestion; wrong choice makes corrections no-op duplicates or retries spurious revisions.

assumptions.item: Metrics named without bounds: ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry; swimming pace has only a lower bound (>45 sec/100m); no upper bound. No ranges invented - treated as unbounded/unvalidated pending operator answer. Single operator list: ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke, swimming pace upper bound.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Sensor Metric Boundary validation incomplete for these metrics.

assumptions.item: Behaviour of packets arriving later than the 60-second Backfill Reorder Window is unspecified (reject, tag, or append as Event Revision).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Affects Telemetry Ingestion invariants on late data.

assumptions.item: Splitting stream buffering/broadcast into a separate context is inferred from the description's 'buffers windowed telemetry streams' and 'event broadcasting'; could be one context.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Merge or split of Telemetry Stream Distribution.

assumptions.item: No security waiver and no AI capability are stated; security is required and no ai_directive is recorded.
